source.original_text:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space equipped with its Borel sigma algebra; zero dimension is allowed. Let alpha,beta>=0, eta be real, V:E->R. Assume exactly alpha>0, alpha<=beta, V is C2, alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for every x,v, eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. All conclusions hold for every y,r in E, initial phase z0=(x0,p0), integer n>=0 and finite T>=0.
Set c=y-eta*grad V(r). For z=(x,p), define Phi_u(z)=(c+cos(u)(x-c)+sqrt(eta)sin(u)p, -sin(u)/sqrt(eta)(x-c)+cos(u)p). Define h_r(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p-[2<p,h_r(x)>/||h_r(x)||^2]h_r(x)) with real division totalized by 0/0=0, lambda_r(x,p)=sqrt(eta)max(0,<p,h_r(x)>), and Lambda_z(u)=integral from0 to u of lambda_r(Phi_s(z)) ds for u>=0, using Lebesgue measure.
A tagged record is either live(a,z), with a>=0, or stopped; Hist_n is the type of all n+1 records. Let Delta_n(T) be the strict simplex 0<t1<...<tn<T. Write a0=0, ai=ti (1<=i<=n), a_(n+1)=T. Given t in Delta_n(T), define z_i=S_r(Phi_(a_i-a_(i-1))(z_(i-1))) for1<=i<=n and K_n(t)_j=live(a_j,z_j). The literal Lean nonnegative conversions preserve these nonnegative times. Define qReal_n(t)=product_(i=1)^n [lambda_r(Phi_(a_i-a_(i-1))(z_(i-1))) exp(-Lambda_(z_(i-1))(a_i-a_(i-1)))], q_n=ofReal(qReal_n).
For arbitrary histories let readTime(live(a,z))=a and readTime(stopped)=0; d_n(T,h)=max(T-readTime(h_n),0). Put W(live(a,z),u)=ofReal(exp(-Lambda_z(u))) and W(stopped,u)=0. Define rho_n(T,t)=q_n(t) W(K_n(t)_n,d_n(T,K_n(t))). Here ofReal(x) is max(x,0) embedded into extended nonnegative reals; no probability law or normalization is assumed in this deterministic identity.
Define Path_T as all phase-valued functions on[0,T]. The total interpolation Psi_n(h)(s) starts at z0 and scans records j=0,...,n in order: a live(a,z) record with a<=s replaces the accumulator by Phi_(max(s-a,0))(z); otherwise it is unchanged. Set Gamma_n(t)=Psi_n(K_n(t)). Extend this particular prescribed path to all real times by gamma(s)=Gamma_n(t)(min(max(s,0),T)). This extension agrees with Gamma on[0,T]; no topology on an entire function space is asserted.
Define momentum reversal R(x,p)=(x,-p), target energy U_y(x,p)=V(x)+||x-y||^2/(2 eta)+||p||^2/2 and unnormalized Gibbs weight w_y(z)=exp(-U_y(z)). For any actual initial state z and strict event tuple t, let P_(y,r,z,n,T)(t)=product_(i=1)^n lambda_r(Phi_(a_i-a_(i-1))(z_(i-1))), I_(y,r,z,n,T)(t)=integral_0^T lambda_r(gamma(s)) ds and dReal_(y,r,z,n,T)(t)=exp(-I_(y,r,z,n,T)(t))*P_(y,r,z,n,T)(t). The incoming-rate product excludes the terminal arrival. The original ENNReal density rho_n(T,t) remains q_n times the terminal live survival factor defined above; it is not redefined as ofReal(dReal).
For each n>=0 and T>=0 there exists a single reversal map rho:Prefix_n(T)->Prefix_n(T), with (rho(t))_i=T-t_(n+1-i) in one-based coordinates. For every y,r,z and strict tuple t, let A=Gamma_(y,r,z,n,T,t)(T). Then both identities hold:
w_y(z) dReal_(y,r,z,n,T)(t) = w_y(R(A)) dReal_(y,r,R(A),n,T)(rho(t)),
ofReal(w_y(z)) rho_(y,r,z,n,T)(t) = ofReal(w_y(R(A))) rho_(y,r,R(A),n,T)(rho(t)).
The reversal map and all internal identities are produced, not assumed. The six original analytic assumptions are the only analytic premises. There is no positivity/nonzero-rate premise and no cancellation of event rates. The conclusions include n=0 with empty product1, T=0, zero-dimensional phase space, zero normals and zero rates; for T=0 and n>0 the strict event subtype is empty. This is unnormalized pointwise weighted density matching in Appendix A.1, not a weighted integral/sector identity, normalized invariant probability, Markov property, hypocoercivity, implementation error, actual expected cost, paper main result or PBPS/SPHMC composition.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
    let Hist : ℕ → Type _ := fun n => Fin (n + 1) → Rec
    let Δ : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Set (Fin n → ℝ) := fun n T =>
      {t | StrictMono (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) t) ∧ ∀ i, t i < (T : ℝ)}
    let Prefix : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Type := fun n T => {t : Fin n → ℝ // t ∈ Δ n T}
    let zAt : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → Fin (n + 1) → (E × E) := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
      Fin.induction z₀ (fun i z =>
        S xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc) z))
    let K : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → Hist n := fun y xRef z₀ n T t j =>
      Sum.inl (Real.toNNReal ((Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j), zAt y xRef z₀ n T t j)
    let qReal : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → ℝ := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
      ∏ i : Fin n,
        rate xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc)
          (zAt y xRef z₀ n T t i.castSucc)) *
        Real.exp (-Λ y xRef (zAt y xRef z₀ n T t i.castSucc)
          (Real.toNNReal (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc)))
    let q : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → ℝ≥0∞ := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (qReal y xRef z₀ n T t)
    let liveTime : Rec → ℝ≥0 := fun r => r.elim Prod.fst (fun _ => 0)
    let d : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Hist n → ℝ≥0 :=
      fun n T h => T - liveTime (h ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩)
    let weight : E → E → Rec → ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0∞ :=
      fun y xRef r u => r.elim
        (fun a => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Λ y xRef a.2 u))) (fun _ => 0)
    let Path : ℝ≥0 → Type _ := fun T => {s : ℝ≥0 // s ≤ T} → E × E
    let Ψ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Hist n → Path T :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T h s =>
        Fin.foldl (n + 1) (fun z j => (h j).elim
          (fun a => if a.1 ≤ s.val then Φ y xRef ((s.val - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2 else z)
          (fun _ => z)) z₀
    let Γ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Prefix n T → Path T :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T t => Ψ y xRef z₀ n T (K y xRef z₀ n T t)
    let ρ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Prefix n T → ℝ≥0∞ :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T t => q y xRef z₀ n T t *
        weight y xRef ((K y xRef z₀ n T t) ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩)
          (d n T (K y xRef z₀ n T t))
    let R : E × E → E × E := fun z => (z.1, -z.2)
    let U : E → E × E → ℝ := fun y z =>
      V z.1 + ‖z.1 - y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) + ‖z.2‖ ^ 2 / 2
    let w : E → E × E → ℝ := fun y z => Real.exp (-U y z)
    let P : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Prefix n T → ℝ :=
      fun y r z n T t => ∏ i : Fin n,
        rate r (Φ y r (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) i.castSucc)
          (zAt y r z n T t i.castSucc))
    let I : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Prefix n T → ℝ :=
      fun y r z n T t => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(T : ℝ),
        rate r (Γ y r z n T t ⟨min (Real.toNNReal s) T, min_le_right _ _⟩)
    let dReal : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Prefix n T → ℝ :=
      fun y r z n T t => Real.exp (-I y r z n T t) * P y r z n T t
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ T : ℝ≥0, ∃ rho : Prefix n T → Prefix n T,
      (∀ t : Prefix n T, ∀ i : Fin n, (rho t).val i = (T : ℝ) - t.val i.rev) ∧
      ∀ y r : E, ∀ z : E × E, ∀ t : Prefix n T,
        let A : E × E := Γ y r z n T t ⟨T, le_rfl⟩
        w y z * dReal y r z n T t = w y (R A) * dReal y r (R A) n T (rho t) ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (w y z) * ρ y r z n T t =
          ENNReal.ofReal (w y (R A)) * ρ y r (R A) n T (rho t)
decoder_context: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including rank zero; real Hilbert gradient and Frechet derivative.
Fin n is zero-based; Fin.rev sends i to n-1-i; Fin.cons prepends and Fin.induction recursively constructs a finite sequence; Fin.foldl visits ascending indices.
Real division by zero is zero; Real.toNNReal is positive part; nonnegative subtraction is truncated; Sum.inl is a live record and Unit is cemetery.

The real path extension is clamped to the closed nonnegative horizon; interval integrals use real Lebesgue measure. ENNReal.ofReal maps a real to its positive part in extended nonnegative reals. Literal let definitions are definitions, not supplied hypotheses.

/-- Weight matching under event-time and terminal momentum reversal. -/
theorem actual_prescribed_weighted_density_balance
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) : actual_prescribed_weighted_density_statement hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη := by
  classical
  unfold actual_prescribed_weighted_density_statement
  intro c Φ S rate Λ Rec Hist Δ Prefix zAt K qReal q liveTime d weight Path Ψ Γ ρ R U w P I dReal n T
  obtain ⟨rho, hrho, h100⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualPrescribedPathReversal.actual_prescribed_path_reversal_and_survival
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη n T
  obtain ⟨rho99, hrho99, h99⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualPrescribedStateReversal.actual_prescribed_state_reversal_and_rate_product
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη n T
  -- The public coordinate equations identify the independently produced witnesses.
  have halign : rho99 = rho := by
    funext t
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext i
    exact (hrho99 t i).trans (hrho t i).symm
  subst rho99
  refine ⟨rho, hrho, ?_⟩
  intro y r z t A
  -- Incoming rates, including zero factors, pair under finite state reversal.
  have hprod : P y r (R A) n T (rho t) = P y r z n T t := by
    simpa only [P, Fin.succ_castSucc, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.cons_succ] using
      (h99 y r z t).2
  -- The reversed survival integral equals the momentum-flipped forward integral.
  have hint : I y r (R A) n T (rho t) =
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(T : ℝ), rate r (R (Γ y r z n T t
        ⟨min (Real.toNNReal s) T, min_le_right _ _⟩)) :=
    (h100 y r z t).2.2.2
  -- Gibbs survival balance and invariance of target energy under momentum flip.
  have hbal :=
    (AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualPrescribedGibbsSurvival.actual_prescribed_gibbs_survival_balance
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη y r z n T t).2.2.2
  have hw : w y (R A) = w y A := by simp only [w, U, R, norm_neg]
  have hs : w y z * Real.exp (-I y r z n T t) =
      w y (R A) * Real.exp (-I y r (R A) n T (rho t)) := by
    rw [hw, hint]
    exact hbal
  -- Multiply by the common event product; no rate cancellation is used.
  have hreal : w y z * dReal y r z n T t =
      w y (R A) * dReal y r (R A) n T (rho t) := by
    dsimp only [dReal]
    rw [hprod, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hs]
  refine ⟨hreal, ?_⟩
  -- Reconnect both real densities to the original algorithmic ENNReal density.
  have hd (a : E × E) (u : Prefix n T) :
      ρ y r a n T u = ENNReal.ofReal (dReal y r a n T u) := by
    simpa only [dReal, I, P, Fin.snoc_castSucc] using
      (AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualPrescribedPathDensity.actual_prescribed_path_density_rewrite
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη y r a n T u).2.2.2
  rw [hd z t, hd (R A) (rho t), ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_nonneg _),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_nonneg _), hreal]

#print axioms actual_prescribed_weighted_density_balance
end

reconstruction.text:
ANONYMOUS MATHEMATICAL RECONSTRUCTION

Fix E,V,α,β,η satisfying the assumptions below and form all of the displayed definitions. For every natural number n and every nonnegative real horizon T, there exists a function J:Prefix(n,T)→Prefix(n,T) such that:

(1) For every prefix t and every i=1,…,n,
    (Jt)ᵢ=T−tₙ₊₁₋ᵢ.
Equivalently, J reverses the event order and reflects each event time in the horizon. This is the existential function called rho in the Lean statement, distinct from the weight ρ.

(2) For every y,r∈E, every initial phase state z∈E×E, and every prefix t∈Prefix(n,T), let A=Γ(y,r,z,n,T,t)(T), the terminal phase state. Then BOTH equalities hold:

    w(y,z) dReal(y,r,z,n,T,t)
      = w(y,R(A)) dReal(y,r,R(A),n,T,Jt),

    ENNReal.ofReal(w(y,z)) ρ(y,r,z,n,T,t)
      = ENNReal.ofReal(w(y,R(A))) ρ(y,r,R(A),n,T,Jt).

The first equality is in ℝ and the second is in ℝ≥0∞. In both, the reversed trajectory starts at the velocity reversal of the forward terminal state, uses the same y,r,V,η,n,T, and uses the reflected event prefix Jt. These are pointwise weighted finite-event trajectory identities. All functions in the statement are literal definitions, not additional hypotheses.

ASSUMPTIONS

1. E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its normed additive commutative group structure. Its measurable space is the Borel measurable space. Dimension zero is permitted.

2. V:E→ℝ is twice continuously Fréchet differentiable (ContDiff ℝ 2 V). The gradient and Hessian use the given real inner product.

3. α,β are nonnegative real numbers, 0<α, and α≤β.

4. For every x,v∈E, α‖v‖² ≤ (D(DV)(x)[v])[v] ≤ β‖v‖². This is the diagonal Hessian quadratic-form bound in every direction, at every point.

5. η is real with η>0 and βη≤1.

DEFINITIONS

notation
Write r for the reference position xRef. For n∈ℕ and T∈ℝ≥0, write a prefix in one-based mathematical notation as t=(t₁,…,tₙ), append t₀=0, and put δᵢ=tᵢ−tᵢ₋₁. This translates Lean index i∈Fin n into event i+1. Scalar products below are real inner products.

c
c(y,r)=y−η∇V(r).

Phi
For a real time u and state z=(x,v), Φ(y,r,u,z)=(c(y,r)+cos(u)(x−c(y,r))+√η sin(u)v, −sin(u)/√η (x−c(y,r))+cos(u)v). The time domain of Φ is all ℝ.

S
Let g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r). S(r,(x,v))=(x,v−[2⟨v,g_r(x)⟩/‖g_r(x)‖²]g_r(x)). Division by zero is defined to be zero; hence if g_r(x)=0 this map fixes (x,v).

rate
λ(r,(x,v))=√η max(0,⟨v,g_r(x)⟩). This is a real-valued nonnegative function; no strictly positive rate assumption is made.

Lambda
Λ(y,r,z,u)=∫₀ᵘ λ(r,Φ(y,r,s,z)) ds for u∈ℝ≥0, using real Lebesgue interval integration and coercing u to ℝ.

Rec
Rec=(ℝ≥0×(E×E))⊕Unit. A live record is inl(a,z) with a nonnegative time and state; the right summand is a single cemetery record.

Hist
Hist(n) is the type of functions Fin(n+1)→Rec, hence exactly n+1 records. There is no chronological or liveness restriction on an arbitrary Hist(n).

Delta
Δ(n,T) is the subset of real vectors Fin n→ℝ for which the prepended vector (0,t₁,…,tₙ) is strictly increasing, and every tᵢ<T. Thus it is precisely 0<t₁<⋯<tₙ<T when n>0.

Prefix
Prefix(n,T) is the subtype of t∈Δ(n,T), including its membership certificate. It is a type, not an asserted probability space or a chosen probability law.

zAt
For initial state z₀, define zᵢ=S(r,Φ(y,r,δᵢ,zᵢ₋₁)) for i=1,…,n. zAt at Lean index j is zⱼ, j=0,…,n. Thus zᵢ is the post-event state, and bᵢ=Φ(y,r,δᵢ,zᵢ₋₁) is the pre-event state.

K
K(y,r,z₀,n,T,t) has record j equal to inl((tⱼ)₊,zⱼ), for j=0,…,n, where (a)₊=Real.toNNReal(a). These particular times are already nonnegative, so their values are tⱼ. All records of K are live.

qReal
qReal(y,r,z₀,n,T,t)=∏ᵢ₌₁ⁿ [λ(r,bᵢ) exp(−Λ(y,r,zᵢ₋₁,(δᵢ)₊))]. The product is 1 for n=0. This prefix weight has no terminal survival factor.

q
q(y,r,z₀,n,T,t)=ENNReal.ofReal(qReal(y,r,z₀,n,T,t)); ENNReal.ofReal sends a real number to its nonnegative part in ℝ≥0∞.

liveTime
liveTime(inl(a,z))=a and liveTime(cemetery)=0.

d
d(n,T,h)=T−liveTime(h(n)) in ℝ≥0, where subtraction is truncated at zero. For a canonical history K this is T−tₙ, with t₀=0 when n=0.

weight
weight(y,r,inl(a,z),u)=ENNReal.ofReal(exp(−Λ(y,r,z,u))); weight(y,r,cemetery,u)=0. The live record time a is not otherwise used by weight.

Path
Path(T) is the full function type {s∈ℝ≥0:s≤T}→E×E. Its definition does not impose continuity, a path topology, measurability, or a probability law.

Psi
For s∈[0,T], Ψ(y,r,z₀,n,T,h)(s) starts with accumulator z₀ and visits j=0,…,n in ascending index order. A cemetery record leaves it unchanged. A live record (a,z) with a≤s overwrites it with Φ(y,r,((s−a) in ℝ≥0),z); if a>s it leaves it unchanged. Consequently an arbitrary history selects the last eligible record by index, not necessarily the greatest record time.

Gamma
Γ(y,r,z₀,n,T,t)=Ψ(y,r,z₀,n,T,K(y,r,z₀,n,T,t)). For canonical ordered histories and each s∈[0,T], let j be the largest index in {0,…,n} such that tⱼ≤s; then Γ(s)=Φ(y,r,s−tⱼ,zⱼ). At each event time tᵢ it takes the post-event value zᵢ. The endpoint is Φ(y,r,T−tₙ,zₙ).

rho_density
ρ(y,r,z₀,n,T,t)=q(y,r,z₀,n,T,t) × weight(y,r,K(y,r,z₀,n,T,t)(n),d(n,T,K(y,r,z₀,n,T,t))). This is the prefix weight times the final survival weight, valued in ℝ≥0∞. The symbol ρ for this weight is distinct from the existential function named rho in the Lean conclusion.

R
R(x,v)=(x,−v).

U
U(y,(x,v))=V(x)+‖x−y‖²/(2η)+‖v‖²/2.

w
w(y,z)=exp(−U(y,z)), a real weight. No normalizing constant is included.

P
P(y,r,z₀,n,T,t)=∏ᵢ₌₁ⁿ λ(r,bᵢ), the product of rates at pre-event states, with empty product 1.

I
I(y,r,z₀,n,T,t)=∫₀ᵀ λ(r,Γ(y,r,z₀,n,T,t)(min((s)₊,T))) ds. The path argument is the nonnegative subtype element min(Real.toNNReal(s),T), equipped with its ≤T proof. This clamps the real integration variable to [0,T]; on the actual interval 0≤s≤T it is s.

dReal
dReal(y,r,z₀,n,T,t)=exp(−I(y,r,z₀,n,T,t))P(y,r,z₀,n,T,t). This is a real weight; it is distinct from the duration d(n,T,h).

QUANTIFIER ORDER AND DEPENDENCIES

Outer parameters: any type E with the listed structures, then any V:E→ℝ, α,β∈ℝ≥0, η∈ℝ satisfying the six named hypotheses hα,hαβ,hV,hH,hη,hβη.

The definitions c,Φ,S,rate,Λ,Rec,Hist,Δ,Prefix,zAt,K,qReal,q,liveTime,d,weight,Path,Ψ,Γ,ρ,R,U,w,P,I,dReal are local let-bindings under those parameters.

∀n∈ℕ ∀T∈ℝ≥0 ∃J:Prefix(n,T)→Prefix(n,T).

One conjunct specifies ∀t∈Prefix(n,T) ∀i∈Fin n, (Jt).val(i)=T−t.val(i.rev).

The other conjunct says ∀y,r∈E ∀z∈E×E ∀t∈Prefix(n,T), with A defined as the forward endpoint, the real equality and the extended-nonnegative equality both hold.

J is selected before y,r,z,t and therefore works uniformly for all of them. Its coordinate rule fixes its event-time values completely; it introduces no choices depending on y,r,z. α and β restrict admissible V and η but do not occur in any trajectory or weight formula.

EDGE CASES AND CONVENTIONS

n=0: Prefix(0,T) contains the unique empty event vector for every T≥0. The coordinate condition on J is empty, both finite products equal 1, K contains only (0,z), and Γ(s)=Φ(y,r,s,z). The terminal survival interval is T. Both identities still assert the corresponding no-event formulas.

T=0 and n>0: Prefix(n,0) is empty because no positive event time lies below zero. The function J exists on the empty type and all prefix-indexed conclusions are vacuous.

T=0 and n=0: the path domain contains just time 0, A=z, Λ over duration zero and I are zero, and qReal=P=dReal=ρ=1. The identities specialize to invariance of w under velocity reversal, also after ENNReal.ofReal.

No event occurs at time 0 or T; no repeated event times are allowed. Endpoints of the path itself ARE included. At an interior event time, Γ uses the post-event state.

When ∇V(x)=∇V(r), the quotient convention makes S the identity and the event rate is zero. This case is not excluded by any binder.

    (Jt)ᵢ=T−tₙ₊₁₋ᵢ.
Equivalently, J reverses the event order and reflects each event time in the horizon. This is the existential function called rho in the Lean statement, distinct from the weight ρ.

    w(y,z) dReal(y,r,z,n,T,t)
      = w(y,R(A)) dReal(y,r,R(A),n,T,Jt),

    ENNReal.ofReal(w(y,z)) ρ(y,r,z,n,T,t)
      = ENNReal.ofReal(w(y,R(A))) ρ(y,r,R(A),n,T,Jt).

The first equality is in ℝ and the second is in ℝ≥0∞. In both, the reversed trajectory starts at the velocity reversal of the forward terminal state, uses the same y,r,V,η,n,T, and uses the reflected event prefix Jt. These are pointwise weighted finite-event trajectory identities. All functions in the statement are literal definitions, not additional hypotheses.
